propositions: The test harness's monkeypatched observed_upsert closure has a narrower signature than the real CriterionBank.upsert, missing evidence_sufficient and seeded keyword-only parameters.

Production code calls upsert with evidence_sufficient and seeded kwargs via record_insufficient, the finalizer, and cache seeding, causing TypeError when the monkeypatch closure rejects unexpected kwargs.
The bedrock LLM arm uniquely triggered the bounded-fallback path that passes evidence_sufficient=False, whereas anthropic and openai gathered sufficient evidence and avoided the fallback.
The fix forwards all keyword arguments through observed_upsert via **kwargs (preserving source for bookkeeping) to maintain signature parity with the real upsert method.
A unit regression test (test_completion_bank_observer_forwarding.py) must validate that evidence_sufficient and seeded flow through the shared wrapper without raising TypeError.
